title: Restoration — The Fractured Planetarium
brief: A modular Three.js Planetarium (room/src/planetarium.js, room/src/main.js, and subsystem modules under room/src/modules/) ships with several interacting, masking, lifecycle, timing, and rendering regressions drawn from a modular bug pool across multiple variants. The agent receives synthesized vague visitor/curator notes (some symptoms may be misleading, masked in multi-stage chains, or completely unreported), must diagnose and fix all underlying defects minimally across room/src/** without breaking normal gallery behaviour, write black-box behavioral regression tests using bench/testing/room-harness.mjs, and classify each root cause from the public taxonomy.

generator.description: seed selects one of 4 variants from a modular bug pool (2 public variants, 2 hidden variants).

state_contract.activeSeed: active seed integer after async seed transition settles
state_contract.orbitAngleDeg: orbit angle of the reference planet (planet 0), degrees, wrapped to [0, 360)
state_contract.chartPatches: array of 12 {x, y} pixel centers of the color-chart patches in the current frame

root_cause_codes_notes: Neutral 24-code public taxonomy given to the agent verbatim. Per-variant mappings and grading criteria reside in hidden-v2/restoration/grade.json.

capture.hidden: hidden-v2/restoration/grade.json (hidden seeds covering remaining variants and multi-seed generalisation checks)

metrics.notes: mean over the planted bugs of each bug's weighted metric score across hidden seeds, viewports, and timestamps
hidden do-no-harm preservation checks across normal gallery features, seeds, timestamps, and remounts
black-box mutant-specificity harness against submission, reference, and single-bug mutants
exact root-cause code match from the public 24-code taxonomy across all planted defects
denominator = sum of comment-stripped reference fix lines for the planted bugs
deterministic work cap vs reference (draw_calls <= ref + 2, triangles <= ref * 1.15, render_passes <= ref + 1)
